Fibrous_Mycelial_Network.description: Not a true skeleton, but a densely woven, semi-solid mass of microscopic hyphal threads forming a humanoid shape. It lacks any vital internal organs, making it horrifyingly resistant to piercing strikes that would instantly kill a mammal.

Solid_Truffle_Core.description: An extremely dense, underground fungal tuber functioning as an immovable anchor chassis. It is immensely heavy and bloated, rendering the entity nearly immobile but capable of shrugging off colossal kinetic impacts.
